asked.text: Should every later non-task PR that touches a task's lines count as an escaped defect? The rule counts any later first-parent commit that changes or deletes such a line, so a feature PR that extends a module or a docs PR counts the same as a bug fix. In this repository's first-parent history the merges by branch prefix are feat 29, docs 8, task 6, fix 5, spec 1: most later commits are not fixes, so the count would measure churn and push the critic rule (R17) the wrong way. Recommended: count only branches named `fix/` or `hotfix/` (or whose PR title starts with 'fix'), and list the others in `fixes` with a `kind` so a human can reclassify.
